text: [warm] Hi, and welcome to Fabric! [excited] In the next two minutes, I'll show you how Fabric turns everyday conversations about your work... into clear, living process maps.

This is your workspace. On the left is the Process Tree: your organization, laid out as functions, departments, and the processes inside them. Click to expand any branch... [curious] or press Control K to jump straight to a process by name.

Every process has its own page, [confident] and this is where it all starts. Hit Start AI interview, and Fabric's voice agent will talk you through how the work really gets done: the steps, the tools, the handoffs. [casual] Prefer to go solo? Record a voice note, or upload a recording you already have.
Every interview lands in the Conversations tab, with the audio, an AI summary, and a full transcript you can read and replay.

[impressed] Now here's where it gets interesting. Fabric reads across every conversation and writes a single overview of the process. It shows where people agree, [thoughtful] where their accounts differ... and which sources back up each point. The more people you interview, the sharper the picture gets.

Open Process Flow to see it all as a map: every step, decision, and handoff, built from what people actually said. Bottlenecks are flagged right on the steps, so you can spot the friction at a glance.
Insights rolls it all up into the numbers: steps, handoffs, tools, decisions, and pain points, each one traced back to the evidence.
[excited] And finally, Automations. Fabric recommends where workflows and AI agents could take work off people's plates... and writes a ready-to-paste brief for Copilot Studio.
[warm] So that's Fabric. Pick a process you know well, hit Start AI interview, and just talk. [cheerful] We'll take care of the rest!
